# LANDED in slice C4 (#1113): .half, .statbox, .dueup, .lineupcard (renamed .entering), .halfdefense, .roster, .rolling__scroll, .winprob, .marginnotes, .pitchers, .halftally, .betweeninnings (a Card button), .abscard (renamed .absframe) are Card now (components/ui/frame/Card.jsx, styles/system/card.css); their rows left this file. Every one is a sheet with a flush body, and each band head stays the first child, as H1b left it. The box score's .bs__defensecard.halfdefense is NOT a Card: it drew no frame before and draws none now. .roster also wears the umpire drawer (UmpireTendenciesFold) and the lineup page's not-posted list; the list sits inside the batting-order card and takes no Card of its own.

# LANDED in slice C3 (#1113): .metriccard (renamed .metric), .lineup, .opp, .startercard (renamed .starter), .teammatecard (renamed .teammate), .defdiamond and .umps__list are Card now (components/ui/frame/Card.jsx, styles/system/card.css); their rows left this file. .lineup__list left too: it is the lineup Card's flush body and draws no frame. The umpire grid keeps its --border-rule ground on the grid inside the Card. .teammatecard__groupmore is .teammate__groupmore. .thub-roster stays a panel row and moved to C6a.

# LANDED in slice C5 (#1113): .gamestory, .bs__team, .bs__decisions, .bs__potg, .bs__insights, .bs__statcastCard, .bs__noteCard, .bs__stars, .stars3__card, .bs__tally, .playercard (renamed .playerline), .bs__info, .bs__totalsCard, .bs__board and .bs__fill are Card now (components/ui/frame/Card.jsx, styles/system/card.css); their rows left this file. Every one takes a flush body; each band head stays the first child, and .gamestory keeps its large title (Gary, 2026-09-29). The six sheets on page paper take the Card's paper (Q3). .bs__fill IS its Card (not wrapped): the phone order ranks it as its column's direct child, and the grid keeps its --border-rule ground. .stars3__card strips the frame below 740px, where it is a list row. .playerline and the phone star row opt out of the Card's clip (it cut the name link's focus ring). .gamestory__link stays a control row.

# LANDED in slice C6a (#1113): .seedcard (renamed .seed), .psseries__result, .psseries__log, .psseries__lboard, .psseries__rostercard, .psseries__upcominglist, .psleaders__teamboard, .allstarrosters__year, .allstarrosters__rows, .allstargame, .allstarlegacy__leadercard and .allstarlegacy__teamcard are Card now (components/ui/frame/Card.jsx, styles/system/card.css); their rows left this file. .psseries__todaycard no longer exists: #1264 replaced that card with the slate GameCard, so its line left too. Every one is flush (each block keeps its own inset) and each head stays the first child. The two <ul>s sit in a flush Card div. .seed is a ledger; only the history page's tap tile is a Card button, and .seed sets overflow: visible so the bracket connectors show. .psseries__lrows and .psseries__rosterlist stay wells, and .allstarlegacy__rankrail stays a navigation strip.

# LANDED in slice C6b (#1113): .rehabcard, .prospects__filterdeck, .milestonewatch-page__card, .umpage__card, .umpage__list, .mgrpage__card, .tradecard (renamed .trade), .umptend, .moredir__card, .aboutrule, .trrank__tile (a Card link), .payboard, .penpage__grid and .trrank__podiumcard are Card now (components/ui/frame/Card.jsx, styles/system/card.css); their rows left this file. Every one takes body="flush" (each block has its own inset), and each head stays the first child. .umpage__list is a <ul> inside a flush Card div. .aboutrule and .penpage__grid are ledgers. .umptend keeps its house band and its four host overrides (.umpmodal, .teaminfo__topzone, .umptendfold, the umpire page).

# LANDED in slice C6c (#1113): .offdaycard (renamed .offday__tile, a Card button with the --offday-accent accent), .foulboard__hero, .foulavg, .gamehigh-tiles, .souvenir-row__tiles, .springcount, .pgame__card, .srecord and .note__stories are Card now (components/ui/frame/Card.jsx, styles/system/card.css); their rows left this file. Every one takes body="flush" (each block has its own inset), and each head stays where it was. .gamehigh-tiles and .souvenir-row__tiles are ledgers whose gap-rule grid (.gamehigh-tiles__grid, .souvenir-row__tilegrid) keeps its --border-rule ground inside the Card. .note__stories is an <ol> inside a flush Card div (.note__storybox holds its margin). .sgh-list took NO Card: it already sat in its board's Card, and a rule shed its frame, so it draws no frame now. The .movedup table, which had no frame, sits in a flush sheet Card (.movedup__card). .note__title and .srecord__title keep their rules until Gary picks a look (H2).

# LANDED in slice C7 (#1113): .sitemenusheet__group, .scorebookstory__gamecard, .scorebookstory__performer, .scorebookstory__leaders, .scorebookstory__nugget, .logbookstats__split (was .logbookstats__splits div), .logbookstats__streak (was .logbookstats__streaks article), .logbookstats__record (was .logbookstats__records > div), .logbookstats__performer, .logbookstats__leaders, .mytally__pitch and .posterstudio__panel are Card now (components/ui/frame/Card.jsx, styles/system/card.css); their rows left this file. Every one takes body="flush" (each block keeps its own inset); each head stays the first child. The game and performer tiles are Card buttons (ledger), drawn by ScorebookGameLink and LogbookGameLink when a caller passes card. The two leaders rules were only a frame, so they are gone. .sitemenusheet__group sits in a modal sheet that stays bespoke (ADR-0037). The three Logbook tag selectors became classes of their own.
